# package typed

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-profinet/gsdml/typed"
```

Package typed is the complete, generated Go model of every GSDML schema version go-profinet has the reference schemas of (Versions): a struct for every complex type, typed fields for every attribute and element, a reflection-free decoder and encoder, and a validator that checks a document against the schema of its version (structure, simple types with every facet, defaults and fixed values, identity constraints) without reading any schema at run time.

The types are deduplicated across versions: a type that is the same in several versions is one struct; a type that differs is one struct per variant, named after the first version of the variant (ModuleItemT\_V231). The packages gsdml/versions/vNNN give each version its own names (v246.ModuleItemT) as aliases of these structs.

The structs are generated by internal/cmd/gsdmlc from the reference schemas (docs/CODEGEN.md); do not edit the zz\_ files.

The validator agrees with libxml2's xmllint on every file of the differential test (TestXSDDifferential); the limits of that evidence are in LIMITATIONS.md.

## Constants

```go
const (
	// MaxDocumentSize is the largest document read, in octets.
	MaxDocumentSize = 64 << 20
	// MaxElements is the largest number of elements in a document.
	MaxElements = 1 << 20
	// MaxDepth is the deepest element nesting.
	MaxDepth = 256
)
```

Limits of Parse and Validate, the same as gsdml's.

```go
const MaxIssues = 1000
```

MaxIssues is the most issues a SchemaError lists.

## Variables

```go
var ErrUnknownVersion = errors.New("typed: unknown GSDML schema version")
```

ErrUnknownVersion is returned for a document whose schema version this package has no schema for.

## Functions

### func DetectVersion

```go
func DetectVersion(data []byte) (string, error)
```

DetectVersion returns the schema version a document names in its root's xsi:schemaLocation ("2.46"), or ErrUnknownVersion.

### func Validate

```go
func Validate(data []byte) error
```

Validate validates a document against the schema of the version it names. The error is a \*SchemaError when the document is not valid, and matches ErrUnknownVersion when it names no known version.

### func ValidateVersion

```go
func ValidateVersion(data []byte, version string) error
```

ValidateVersion validates a document against the schema of version, whatever version the document names.

```go
func Versions() []string
```

Versions returns the schema versions this package has, oldest first.

### type Integer


### type Node

```go
type Node struct {
	Name  xml.Name
	Attrs []xml.Attr
	// Children is the content in document order: elements, and text
	// nodes (Name.Local empty) with their character data in Text.
	Children []*Node
	Text     string
	// Line is the line of the start tag, 0 for a node built in memory.
	Line int
	// ns is the in-scope namespace declarations, for QName values.

}
```

Node is an XML element as the schema sees it: its name, attributes (without namespace declarations), and content. It holds content that the schemas leave open (xsd:any, mixed content, xsd:anyType) verbatim.

#### func ParseNode

```go
func ParseNode(data []byte) (*Node, error)
```

ParseNode reads an XML document into a Node tree, with the limits of this package. UTF-8 (with or without a byte order mark), ISO-8859-1 and windows-1252 are accepted, as gsdml accepts them. A document type declaration with an internal subset is refused (its declarations would apply, and encoding/xml does not apply them).


Attr returns the value of an attribute.


CharData returns the concatenated character data of the node's direct text children.

### type Versioned

```go
type Versioned interface {
	// SchemaVersion is the GSDML version, "2.46".
	SchemaVersion() string
	// Encode writes the document as XML.
	Encode(w io.Writer) error
	// RootElement returns the root (*ISO15745Profile_Vnnn).
	RootElement() any
}
```

Versioned is a typed document of some schema version: a \*Document\[T] for the root type T of that version.

#### func Decode

```go
func Decode(data []byte) (Versioned, error)
```

Decode returns the typed model of a document as the version it names without validating it. It fails on what the model cannot hold (an element or attribute not in the schema, a value that does not parse as its type), and accepts what only validation rejects (order, counts, facets, identity constraints).

#### func DecodeVersion

```go
func DecodeVersion(data []byte, version string) (Versioned, error)
```

DecodeVersion is Decode with the version given.

#### func Parse

```go
func Parse(data []byte) (Versioned, error)
```

Parse validates a document against the schema of the version it names and returns its typed model.

#### func ParseVersion

```go
func ParseVersion(data []byte, version string) (Versioned, error)
```

ParseVersion is Parse with the version given: the document is validated against, and decoded as, that version.
